dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: We have had a bit of a setback.
dialogue.amharic: ትንሽ ችግር ገጥሞናል።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: I'm sorry but that's an accurate description. What else do you want me to call it?
dialogue.amharic: ይቅርታ፡ ግን ትክክለኛው ገለጻ እሱ ነው። ሌላ ምን ልበለው?

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: How about "your fault"? How about that?
dialogue.amharic: "የአንተ ጥፋት" ብትለውስ? እንዴት ነው?

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: No, no, don't lay that on me.
dialogue.amharic: አይ፡ አይ! እኔ ላይ አታሳብብ።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: You are in charge of distribution. You said expand the territory. That doesn't mean you become careless.
dialogue.amharic: ማከፋፈሉ ያንተ ኃላፊነት ነው። ግዛቱን እናስፋ አልክ፡ ያ ማለት ግን ተዘናጋ ማለት አይደለም።

dialogue.speaker: Saul
dialogue.source_text: Guys, guys! Hey! Who do I look like, Maury Povich? I'm not your marriage counselor. Now, you're professionals. Act like it. Now. Setback. Go.
dialogue.amharic: ኧረ ተዉ! የትዳር አማካሪያችሁ መሰልኳችሁ? ሙያተኞች ናችሁ፡ እንደዛ ሁኑ። አሁን ችግሩን ንገሩኝ።

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: One of our dealers was murdered. It was some kind of turf dispute and apparently we lost. And then everyone quit on us. I mean, we have absolutely no distribution.
dialogue.amharic: አንዱ አከፋፋያችን ተገደለ። የቦታ ግጭት ነበር፡ ተሸነፍን። ሌሎቹም ጥለውን ወጡ። አሁን ምንም አከፋፋይ የለንም።

dialogue.speaker: Saul
dialogue.source_text: Is there any way any of this can be traced back to you? Now, the police, I'm talking about.
dialogue.amharic: ነገሩ ወደ እናንተ ሊያያዝ ይችላል? ፖሊሶቹን ማለቴ ነው።

dialogue.speaker: Saul
dialogue.source_text: Well, there's your silver lining. How about you? How's the, uh, health situation?
dialogue.amharic: ቢያንስ እሱ ጥሩ ነው! አንተስ? የጤናህ ነገር እንዴት ነው?

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: It's, uh, better. Do you mind? Better? Yeah, it's, uh… It's looking a little more positive. I may have more time than I thought.
dialogue.amharic: ተሻሽሏል። ተሻሽሏል? አዎ... ተስፋ ሰጪ ይመስላል። ካሰብኩት በላይ ጊዜ አለኝ።

dialogue.speaker: Saul
dialogue.source_text: Outstanding. Now, as to your dead guy: uh, occupational hazard. Drug dealer getting shot? I'm gonna go out on a limb here and say it's been known to happen. Now, what about product on hand? How's your inventory?
dialogue.amharic: በጣም ጥሩ። የሞተው ሰው የሥራ አደጋ ነው፤ እፅ ነጋዴ መመታቱ የተለመደ ነው። በእጃችሁ ያለው እፅስ? ስንት አለ?

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Thirty-eight and change.
dialogue.amharic: ሰላሳ ስምንት ከምናምን።

dialogue.speaker: Saul
dialogue.source_text: Thirty-eight ounces? Grams? Pounds.
dialogue.amharic: ሰላሳ ስምንት አውንስ? ግራም?... ፓውንድ?

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Pounds. You did say make hay while the sun is shining.
dialogue.amharic: ፓውንድ! ዕድሉን ተጠቀሙበት ያለው ማን ነበር?

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: Guys. Why the long faces here? I mean, you're sitting on a gold mine. A gold mine we can't sell. We need a proper infrastructure. We need foot soldiers and we need dealers on a street level that are rock solid. We need muscle and we need enforcers. Payback. That's what we need.
dialogue.amharic: ምን አፋችሁን አስያዛችሁ? የወርቅ ማዕድን እጃችሁ ላይ አለ! ግን ልንሸጠው አልቻልንም። ጠንካራ መዋቅር፡ የጎዳና ላይ ሻጮች እና የጥበቃ ኃይል ያስፈልገናል።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: God. I mean, this entire process has just been so… It's always been one step forward and two steps back. We need your help.
dialogue.amharic: በቃ እኮ... ነገራችን ሁሉ አንድ እርምጃ ወደፊት፡ ሁለት እርምጃ ወደኋላ ሆነ። እርዳታህ ያስፈልገናል።

dialogue.speaker: Saul
dialogue.source_text: Look, let's start with some tough love, all right? Ready for this? Here goes. You two suck at peddling meth. Period. So give up on trying to do it all yourselves. Hell, I'm amazed you got this far. Look, we are not going to deal with another high-level distributor. No, thank you. We have been down that road. What, some tattooed speed freak? No. What you two need is an honest-to-God businessman. All right? Somebody who treats your product like the simple high-margin commodity that it is. Somebody who ships out of town, deals only in bulk. Someone who's been doing this for 20 years and never been caught. You know someone like that?
dialogue.amharic: እውነቱን ልንገራችሁ? ሁለታችሁም እፅ መሸጥ አትችሉም። በቃ! እስካሁን መድረሳችሁ ተአምር ነው። ከሌላ ህገወጥ አከፋፋይ ጋር አንሰራም። እናንተ የምትፈልጉት እውነተኛ ነጋዴ ነው። በጅምላ የሚሸጥ፡ ለ20 ዓመት ሳይያዝ የሰራ ሰው። እንደዚህ ያለ ሰው ታውቃላችሁ?

dialogue.speaker: Saul
dialogue.source_text: Let's just say I know a guy who knows a guy. Who knows another guy. Let me make some calls, see if I can get you a meeting.
dialogue.amharic: ሰው የሚያውቅ ሰው አውቃለሁ። ደውዬ ቀጠሮ ለመያዝ ልሞክር።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: Well, what's his name?
dialogue.amharic: ስሙ ማን ነው?

dialogue.speaker: Saul
dialogue.source_text: I have no idea. He's very low profile. He's careful like that. You know, from what I do hear about him, he sounds a little like you.
dialogue.amharic: አላውቅም። በጣም ጥንቁቅ እና ምስጢራዊ ነው። ከምሰማው ነገር ግን፡ ትንሽ አንተን ይመስላል።
